definitions.explanation: Suffix attaching to a noun to form the name of a historical field or written history. Common in academic, journalistic, and book-title vocabulary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{史|し}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{史|し}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。

⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧{史|し}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{概論|がいろん}→概論：04126_gairon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受講|じゅこう}→受講：15937_jukou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took an introductory course on modern art history at university.

notes:
Names the history of a country, field, era, or institution. Productive in academic and book titles.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{史|し}: Japanese history
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{史|し}: world history
- ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧{史|し}: art history
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧{史|し}: modern history
- ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧{史|し}: ancient history
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧{史|し}: company history

USAGE:
Also used in academic field names: ⟦{歴史|れきし}{学|がく}→歴史学：23679_rekishigaku⟧ (the discipline of history) vs. ~{史|し} (a specific historical subject). In Japanese high school, students typically choose between ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{史|し} and ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{史|し}.
